name: folder-list
title: Folder List
description: Maps folders with parent IDs, optional recursion, depth limits and exclusions.

settings.name: path
settings.title: Path
settings.description: Folder whose immediate subfolders are listed.

settings.description: World folder used for the default report location.

settings.description: Root is depth 0; direct children are depth 1. Omit for unlimited recursive depth.

settings.name: exclude
settings.title: Exclude Paths
settings.description: Array of absolute paths or paths relative to the scan root.
